title: Pricing Desk Statement — The Amended Annual Fee of an Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscription
content:
# The Amended Annual Fee

Pricing desk statement of the annual fee a subscription under Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions carries once the metered points the site meters are taken onto it.

## The fee

The amended annual fee is the fee the amendment is struck on, plus the per-point fee for every point the subscription covers after the amendment, plus the charge for the points beyond the tier's included count, plus the charge for the dashboard users beyond the tier's included count, plus the data gateway charge; the five parts are added and the total is rounded to the nearest cent once at the end. The points beyond the tier's included count and the dashboard users beyond the tier's included count are carried inside the amended annual fee for the whole of each year it stands, and are not billed as a separate line.

## The five parts

1. **The points the site meters** are counted as the metered points that posted a reading in the month ending on the day of the amendment, one reading to a point. This is the count the subscription covers after the amendment.
2. **The fee the amendment is struck on** is the tier's annual subscription fee.
3. **The per-point fee** is the tier's annual fee per included meter, carried once for every point the subscription covers after the amendment.
4. **The charge for points beyond the included count.** Every point beyond the tier's included count carries the tier's meter overage fee.
5. **The charge for dashboard users beyond the included count.** Every dashboard user beyond the tier's included count carries the tier's dashboard user fee.
6. **The data gateway charge** is the tier's gateway fee.

## Order of the arithmetic

Each of the five parts is worked out in full before any of them is added, and nothing is rounded on the way: the per-point part is the whole count of covered points multiplied by the per-point fee, the points-beyond part the count beyond the included figure multiplied by the overage fee, the users-beyond part the count beyond the included figure multiplied by the user fee. The five are then added, and that single total is rounded to the nearest cent.

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

A subscription at a tier whose annual subscription fee is USD 8400, whose per included meter fee is USD 210 a year, whose meter overage fee is USD 150 a year, which includes 12 meters and 10 dashboard users at USD 150 a user, and whose gateway fee is USD 540 a year. Fourteen metered points posted a reading in the month ending on the day of the amendment, and the subscription carries 11 named dashboard users.

- Fee struck on: USD 8400.00.
- Per-point: 14 points multiplied by USD 210, that is USD 2940.00.
- Points beyond: 14 less 12 included, so 2 points multiplied by USD 150, that is USD 300.00.
- Users beyond: 11 less 10 included, so 1 user at USD 150, that is USD 150.00.
- Gateway: USD 540.00.
- Added: 8400.00 plus 2940.00 plus 300.00 plus 150.00 plus 540.00, rounded once — **USD 12330.00**.
